configDefinition.name: sync_server
configDefinition.description: URI of the synchronization server coordinating playback across screens.

configDefinition.name: sync_group
configDefinition.description: Group identifier so screens in the same wall stay in sync.

configDefinition.name: items
configDefinition.description: JSON array of video objects ({uid, uri}) to play on this screen. Falls back to demo videos when empty.

configDefinition.name: mode
configDefinition.description: Debug shows the playback-status readout and on-screen log console; production hides everything except the title and device-info section. Defaults to production.
